diff --git a/doc/whats-new.rst b/doc/whats-new.rst
index 2809ea90..c0b9c21e 100644
--- a/doc/whats-new.rst
+++ b/doc/whats-new.rst
@@ -28,6 +28,9 @@ Breaking Changes
   not intended to be visible to end-users so this version of xarray
   switches to using ``FutureWarning`` everywhere (:pull:`11112`).
   By `Julia Signell <https://github.com/jsignell>`_.
+- :py:meth:`DataArray.copy` now defaults to a shallow copy (``deep=False``),
+  consistent with :py:meth:`Dataset.copy`. Pass ``deep=True`` to keep the
+  previous behaviour.
 
 Deprecations
 ~~~~~~~~~~~~

         return self._from_temp_dataset(ds)
 
-    def copy(self, deep: bool = True, data: Any = None) -> Self:
+    def copy(self, deep: bool = False, data: Any = None) -> Self:
         """Returns a copy of this array.
 
         If `deep=True`, a deep copy is made of the data array.
@@ -1280,7 +1280,7 @@ class DataArray(
